# Files

- [Vendor nametag firmware (Arduino)](nametag-firmware.md) - The riatlabs cdc-badge-nametag firmware — a minimal Arduino/PlatformIO program that brings up I²C, the BQ25895, SPI, the TCA9535 keypad, NVS settings, the GxEPD2 e-paper and a TROPIC01 session, then shows a static nametag with frontlight control; useful as a second source of truth for drivers and pins, with its known inaccuracies listed.
